Name: Teleshopping 1.0
Author: TerrorNiko02
Description:
[b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]
Bring the excitement of TV shopping to Stardew Valley!
[b]Teleshopping Channel[/b] adds a brand-new TV channel to your farmhouse television, allowing you to browse a carefully curated catalog of products from the comfort of your home. Every week, the selection changes with [b]10 new items[/b], giving you fresh reasons to tune in regularly and discover what's on sale.
Instead of visiting multiple shops around Pelican Town, simply switch on your TV, browse the current weekly offers through a polished and immersive shopping interface, and place your order. Your purchases will be delivered the next morning in a [b]vanilla-style package[/b] waiting right outside your farmhouse.
The entire experience has been designed to feel like an official Stardew Valley feature, seamlessly blending into the game's art style, UI, and gameplay.
[line]
[size=5][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Download the latest release of [b]Teleshopping Channel[/b].[/*]
[*]Extract the mod into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Turn on your TV and select the new [b]Teleshopping[/b] channel.[/*]
[/list]If updating from an older version, simply replace the existing mod folder with the new one.
[line]
[b][size=5]Main Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]📺 Adds a brand-new [b]Teleshopping TV Channel[/b].[/*]
[*]🛍️ Browse a beautifully designed in-game shopping interface.[/*]
[*]🔄 [b]10 new products every in-game week[/b], keeping the catalog fresh and exciting.[/*]
[*]💰 Dynamic pricing with configurable price multipliers.[/*]
[*]🔍 Search products quickly using the integrated search bar.[/*]
[*]📦 Orders are delivered the following morning in a [b]vanilla-style package[/b] placed outside your farmhouse.[/*]
[*]🌾 Carefully designed to match Stardew Valley's vanilla aesthetics and gameplay.[/*]
[*]🎮 Full mouse, keyboard, and controller support.[/*]
[*]🌐 Multiplayer compatible.[/*]
[*]⚙️ Multiple configuration options for balancing and customization.[/*]
[*]🧩 Automatically supports many items from other mods that are properly registered with Stardew Valley's Item Registry.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b]
Required
[list]
[*]SMAPI (latest version)[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[/list]Recommended
While not required, this mod works especially well alongside content mods that add new crops, artisan goods, furniture, and other items, as eligible modded items can appear in the weekly Teleshopping catalog.
